entries.0b7ae6476dc595ec: This division centers on photosensitive materials such as photoresists. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥124,700 million, and these products are sold as materials for semiconductors and displays. At the Koriyama Plant, construction of a new photoresist production building is underway.
entries.48d1ed4aa40a153a: Electronics-related manufacturers such as semiconductor manufacturers
entries.cb503ad069d7a8dd: A chemical materials manufacturer that makes and sells electronics functional materials such as photoresists used in manufacturing semiconductors and other products, and high-purity chemicals.
entries.ceaac18c39d6c713: This is the group's only reportable segment, which manufactures and sells electronics functional materials and high-purity chemicals. It consists of the company, eight subsidiaries (of which two are unconsolidated) and three affiliates (of which two are not accounted for under the equity method), and consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥237,029 million. In addition to Japan, it has manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in the United States, Taiwan, South Korea and China, and supplies materials to customers such as semiconductor manufacturers.
entries.d06e33e2887d5b15: This is a revenue category outside the above two divisions. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,928 million.
entries.d6a8f83d9245d5f7: This division handles high-purity chemicals used in manufacturing processes such as semiconductors. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥109,400 million. In South Korea, a new inspection building in Incheon Metropolitan City has been completed, and construction of a new high-purity chemicals production building is underway on land acquired in Pyeongtaek.
